# Umbrella Corporation — The Hive Access Badge System

> Official Umbrella Corporation Security & Personnel Credential Registry for Raccoon City Underground Research Facility (The Hive). Create, customize, preview, and issue verified Personnel Badges, Departmental Facility Keycards, and Classified Directorate Security Passes.

## Core Capabilities
- **Style A — Personnel Identification Badge**: Vertical white credential featuring the classic 8-segment Umbrella octagon emblem, red-bordered operative portrait, charcoal name band, Security Clearance Level 1–5/A, biometric physical specifications (Division, Height, Weight, Eyes, Hair), and scannable optical verification code.
- **Style B — Facility Zone Keycard**: Minimalist vertical departmental access keycard with large centered Umbrella octagon, division bar (Security, U.B.C.S., Special Security, Lab Staff, Facility Ops, Executive), clearance tier, and optical checkpoint code.
- **Style C — Classified Directorate Pass (Hive Black Edition)**: Horizontal CR80 dark security pass featuring the 3D Umbrella watermark, metallic crest, portrait & red-boxed Security Level Clearance badge, personal dossier record (Year of Birth, Sex, Blood Group, Authorized Sectors, Primary & Secondary Posts, Registry Serial), dermal ridge fingerprint scan, gold EMV smart chip, edge-to-edge barcode strip, and corporate motto *"OUR BUSINESS IS LIFE ITSELF"*.

## Verified Personnel Dossiers
- **Alice Abernathy**: Security Personnel • Clearance Level 5 (`/?preset=alice`)
- **Carlos Olivera**: U.B.C.S. (Umbrella Biohazard Countermeasure Service) • Clearance Level 5 (`/?preset=carlos`)

- **HUNK (Alpha Team)**: U.S.S. (Umbrella Security Service) • Clearance Level 5 (`/?preset=hunk`)
